map.铁人三项总完赛时间 = 游泳 + 骑车 + 跑步: A triathlon transition-time calculator: sum swim, bike and run segment times with transition times to get the total time and each segment’s share for race-pace analysis.
map.铁三按三项成绩算转换时间占比，识别转换短板针对性练换项。: In triathlon, compute the transition share from the three segment times, identify the transition weakness and train it specifically.
map.T1（泳→骑）目标 ≤90 s，T2（骑→跑）≤60 s；慢转换可丢名次。: Target T1 (swim → bike) ≤90 s and T2 (bike → run) ≤60 s; slow transitions can cost places.
map.专项模拟换项，减少多余动作。: Simulate transitions specifically and cut out unnecessary movements.
map.常被忽略却直接影响总时，专项换项演练性价比高，精英间差距常在换项。: It is often overlooked yet directly affects total time; targeted transition practice gives a high return, and among elites the difference is often in transition.
map.铁人三项转换时间（游泳/骑车/跑步）。体育竞技工具，帮助计算与分析运动数据。: Triathlon Transition Time Calculator. A sports tool that helps calculate and analyze athletic data.
map.总时长 = 游泳 + 换项 T1 + 骑车 + 换项 T2 + 跑步；折合分钟: Total time = swim + transition T1 + bike + transition T2 + run; minutes = total / 60; hours = total / 3600; three-segment average = (swim + bike + run) / 3 (transitions excluded); transition total = T1 + T2; each segment share = segment seconds / total x 100. In the h:m:s display, hours = floor(total / 3600), minutes = floor((total mod 3600) / 60) and seconds = total rounded as a whole then mod 60 (so 3599.6 s shows 1时0分0秒 instead of 59分60秒). Validation: any negative segment stops the calculation and echoes all five raw values.
